description: ★ One of our best tools. Search, read and summarise in one call (open-sources tier): finds pages via Wikipedia, Hacker News, DuckDuckGo and Stack Overflow, reads the top ones (robots.txt respected) and writes a concise cited answer, plus pages read and all results. Upgrades itself to full-web search (and price) when a premium index is connected. Price: $0.03 in USDC per call (x402 or prepaid credits). Paid only (not in the free trial). Try search-open free first.
